contracts: LPCON permits request bits0WIFIPWR/1COEX/2I2C only. FORCE remains I2C2-only; LP_TIMER/other force engines reject. Bit1 does not select independent SYSCON+04 bit12 160MHz source.
Value3 does not grant REGI2C or override MODEM_APB/LP_APB/I2C permissions, create analog targets, complete PLL/SAR/BOD or produce COEX/RF/MAC/PHY readiness. Getter/report are requests only.

write_at settles old I2C inputs first. Parent exact+18 path services old watchdogs even before rejecting partial writes. Strict exact refusals are ModelLimit and preserve guest destination/CSRs; adjacent and off-profile unknown words retain prior mapping.

Four new Bus/guest cases cover actual field RMW, independent bits/source, no I2C/APB grant, plain/UnitCost bad-bit/byte/halfword preservation, CPU retention/HP reset and watchdog precedence against correctly elapsed expected state.

SHTC3@70 is routed through host0 SDA27/SCL26. Existing C5I2c sync advances board/sensor time before START/data callbacks. No new controller/Bus hook, trait slot, callback stub or public environment API.

The declared virtual25C/50%RH uses datasheet-maximum guest deadlines:240us startup/wake/reset,12.1ms normal and0.8ms low-power. Busy addresses NACK; samples latch at command start; finite/range/overflow checks prevent early completion.
Virtual0807 is a product-ID mask with unspecified bits0, not a serial or earlier2638 garbage. Two-byte early STOP and three-byte CRC ID reads plus four no-stretch measurement commands are supported.

Powered sensor busy/sleep survives controller/CPU reset; only physical power edges reset it. Stretch/general-call/serial and result retries without a fresh command remain unsupported. Large catch-up is callback-horizon timing, not calibrated byte-phase ACK/line behavior.

negativeResults.reasonAndCorrection: 479 library cases passed and1 failed: a fixture compared the owner against its time0 clone. Old watchdog service correctly settles autonomous time to129999999. Compare against an independently elapsed expected owner instead; no production change.

limits: No original LCD output, SD commands, UI/button/FAT mount/persistence acceptance or C5 publication.
RTC/QMI init and SHT ID do not prove complete sensor/application behavior or physical environment calibration.
CLK_CONF1 remains unimplemented and produces an existing cause5 access fault. No guessed value or radio ready response is supplied.
Focused LTO=false C5 and explicitly filtered SHT tests do not replace default-LTO full-workspace/retained CI/CPU controls/current production WASM/browser/fresh product acceptance.
Production WASM remains the historical pre-KM/coex/USB artifact; Clippy is not a production build or browser result.
